content.study:
Section 43M — Chief Executive Officer

Section 43M provides for a Chief Executive Officer responsible for day-to-day administration of the Arbitration Council of India and addresses the statutory framework for the Secretariat, qualifications, appointment and service conditions.

The provision belongs to the Arbitration Council of India framework and must be read with applicable regulations and commencement notifications.
